newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline advances with crude in tight supply.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline advances with crude in tight supply.

text.p: NWE gasoline advanced with crude on Monday after Iraq's incursion into its Kurdish region led the U.N. to further delay Iraqi oil exports, traders said.
Eurograde gasoline barges jumped $11 from Friday to trade around $216.50 fob ARA, with some good buying in early business as a number of buyers sought to cover short positions.
Supplies of gasoline are still tight. Traders said this was due to maintenance and refiners maximising on more profitable products like jet and gas oil at the expense of gasoline.
The Labor Day holiday in the U.S. kept talk of transatlantic arbitrage thin. --Colin Wooster, London Newsroom +44 171 542 7456
